Hero.subtitle: A modern Middle Eastern kitchen where oak fire, Gulf seafood and the spice routes of the Levant meet at one table.

Story.title: Born around a fire, raised on the spice routes.
Story.body1: Ember & Saffron began as a backyard grill in Beirut and a grandmother's saffron tin in Isfahan. Today it lives in the heart of DIFC — an open kitchen built around a 1,200° oak hearth.
Story.body2: We cook the way our families did: slowly, generously and always for sharing. Every spice is toasted and ground in-house, every bread is pulled from the fire to order.

Chef.quote: Fire is the oldest ingredient. Saffron is the most patient. Everything we cook lives somewhere between the two.
Chef.bio: Trained in Paris and Istanbul, Karim spent a decade cooking across the Levant and the Gulf before opening Ember & Saffron. His menu changes with the seasons and the catch — but always starts at the hearth.
